statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: A BGP speaker may transmit routes with overlapping Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI) to another BGP speaker.

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: If a BGP speaker receives overlapping routes, the Decision Process MUST consider both routes based on the configured acceptance policy.
actions: Consider both routes based on configured acceptance policy

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: If both a less and a more specific route are accepted, then the Decision Process MUST install, in Loc-RIB, either both the less and the more specific routes or aggregate the two routes and install, in Loc-RIB, the aggregated route, provided that both routes have the same value of the NEXT_HOP attribute.
statements.pre_cond: route.less_specific.accepted = true & route.more_specific.accepted = true & route.less_specific.NEXT_HOP = route.more_specific.NEXT_HOP
actions: Install both less-specific and more-specific routes in Loc-RIB OR aggregate the two routes and install aggregated route in Loc-RIB

statements.subject: bgp
statements.description: If a BGP speaker chooses to aggregate, then it SHOULD either include all ASes used to form the aggregate in an AS_SET, or add the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute to the route.
actions: Include all ASes used to form the aggregate in an AS_SET OR add ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute to the route

statements.subject: message
statements.description: In particular, a route that carries the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute MUST NOT be de-aggregated.
actions: Do not de-aggregate a route carrying the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute
